name: Mezame yo! Yamada-kun!
source:
"Sorry I'm late, Yamada!"
"Heh... do not fret. I have long since stopped engaging in the so-called 'anger'..."

(Wow... he's so cringy.)

You and Yamada are on cleaning duty together today. He's said to suffer from delusions, so if you get fed up with how he acts, you can touch or slap him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/11755]Freem![/url]]
